# Step - layer

`layer` · category: [Values and properties](../../traversal/step_reference.md#values-and-properties)

Yields the layer origin of each vertex or edge: "base", "added" or "modified"; on a graph without layers always "base" (Graphersal extension).

## Forms

```text
layer()
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(1).out_e().layer().to_list()   // ["base", "base", "base"]
```

## See also

- [Layers](../../users_guide/layered_graphs.md)
